# npm Registry

2 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/npm/package - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one published version of an npm package, the latest by default: the package name (`post.id` and `post.ext.title`), its npm page and description (`post.content.text`). `post.ext.npm` adds the version, licence, homepage, repository, keywords, maintainers by username, its dependencies, peer dependencies and supported engines, and the tarball link with its integrity hash, unpacked size and file count. A package or version npm does not have answers 404 and is not charged.

**Use when** you want to check a dependency before adding it, audit what a version pulls in, or verify a download.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `package` (optional, string) - The package name, with its scope when it has one, for example zod or @vue/server-renderer. Send package or url. · e.g. `zod`
- `url` (optional, string) - The package's npm page, for example https://www.npmjs.com/package/zod (a /v/<version> link picks that version). Send package or url.
- `version` (optional, string) - A published version such as 3.22.4, or a tag such as latest (default) or next.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `package`, `url`.

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.ext.title` | The post title on its own. |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+5 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.ext` {npm}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.display_name`, `post.author.username`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.content.thumbnail_url`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.engagement.views` (+1 more).

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/npm/package" \
  --data-urlencode "package=zod" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/npm/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the npm packages matching search terms, ranked by npm, 20 a page by default and up to 100, for up to 100 pages, with npm's total for the search. Search terms take npm's own qualifiers, for example keywords:react or author:sindresorhus. Each package is a Post: the package name (`post.id` and `post.ext.title`, the name GET /v1/npm/package takes), its npm page and description (`post.content.text`). `post.ext.npm` adds the latest version, licence, homepage, repository, keywords, maintainers by username, when the version was published, weekly and monthly downloads and the number of dependents. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to find libraries for a task, compare their adoption, or track packages in an ecosystem.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 20/page by default, max 100; set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/20) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search terms, 1 to 300 characters, for example react state, with npm qualifiers such as keywords:hooks. · e.g. `react state`
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Page number from 1 to 100. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Packages per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.ext.title` | The post title on its own. |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+5 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.ext` {npm}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.display_name`, `post.author.username`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.content.thumbnail_url`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.engagement.views` (+1 more). Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/npm/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=react state" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
